summary_1line: Yudhishthira decides Draupadi will be the common wife of the five brothers, while Krishna secretly meets the disguised Pandavas and Dhrishtadyumna spies on them.

image_candidates.scene_text: The five Pandava brothers sit in a humble potter’s hut, all gazing at the radiant Draupadi as desire silently fills the room.
Krishna and Balarama enter the potter’s house and bow at Yudhishthira’s feet while the disguised Pandavas sit around him like fire in the dim hut.
At night the Pandavas lie on beds of kusa grass on the floor while Draupadi rests at their feet and Dhrishtadyumna secretly watches from hiding.
